title: Story Sequencer
summary: A storyboard desk where shuffled 4-8 frame stories are reordered, cause-and-effect linked and titled.
mobileSupportNote: Phone portrait works in a compact two-column shelf and a single-column board with move buttons as the primary reorder path, but the storyboard experience is designed for tablet and desktop.

cover.alt: Staged mid-story state of the storyboard: five comic panels in one row on the teal desk, issue 1 in its solved order with yellow-highlighted time clues (One bright morning, Soon, Then, Later, Finally) underlined in the captions, and two rust pencil connectors with large cause/effect chips linking the wind to the flying kite and the rain to the run home; step chips show 2. LINK active.

desktop.alt: Honest default landing state at 1440x900: the story shelf with the STORY SEQUENCER masthead (0 of 5 sequenced), five sand-paper comic issue cards in one row showing cover art (kite, birdhouse, tomatoes, night window, paper boat), each titled 'Title to be written' with panel and link counts.

tablet.alt: Honest tablet view of the story shelf at 1024x768: four comic issue cards fill the first row and the fifth wraps alone onto a second row beneath the first card; the whole shelf fits with no scrollbar, teal desk and masthead progress counter visible.

mobile.alt: Limited mobile support at 390x844: the shelf reflows to a two-column grid of comic issue cards (limited support — the board itself favours tablet and desktop).
